verdict.summary: Round 7 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue. The specification consistently limits unreadable-versus-absent bound-index solution indistinguishability to requesters whose eligible entry set is empty, while SV-ND-4 expressly permits the existence and dimension observables for requesters holding eligible entries. The related discovery requirements and conformance scenario preserve that same boundary. The change remains an honest proposal: it identifies implementation gaps, requires authorization before ranking, rejects shared approximate structures whose results depend on unreadable entries, and makes no unsupported implementation, privacy, or performance claim.
